newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales up 0.4 pct--BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales up 0.4 pct--BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales rose 0.4 percent in the week ended August 16 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 3.5 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was unchanged from the prior month.
"Sales were generally on plan for the week," the report said.
The report, which is normally embargoed for public access at 0900 EDT/1300 GMT, was released early by other news agencies.
